notes: Read SKILL.md in full; it is the only file. FinOps guide for AWS: a cost-review workflow, Cost Explorer queries, budgets and anomaly detection, a billing alarm, discovery of unused resources, S3 lifecycle tiering, Terraform budget/alarm resources, and scheduled non-production shutdowns.

Most commands are read-only cost and inventory queries, and the unused-resource section only lists candidates without deleting them. State-changing commands use the user's AWS credentials: creating budgets, anomaly monitors and alarms, applying an S3 lifecycle policy that moves data to Glacier/Deep Archive and expires noncurrent versions after 90 days (SKILL.md:206-231), stopping all running instances tagged Environment=dev (SKILL.md:283-286), and scaling a dev ECS service to zero (SKILL.md:289-292). Medium because of those changes; acceptable because they are scoped to cost controls and dev resources the user chooses to target. Users should confirm the lifecycle policy before applying it to a real bucket.

Account IDs, ARNs, email addresses and dates are placeholders. Related Skills (SKILL.md:310-314) link to sibling skills (../aws-ec2/, ../aws-s3/, ../aws-rds/, ../aws-lambda/, ../terraform-aws/) that do not ship with this skill; optional. Frontmatter declares license: MIT.
